name: Live Activities
description: Shows Home Assistant live activities as native cards over the screensaver: appliances, vacuums, climate, charging, solar, travel times and any other entity. Each card shows a status, a progress bar or current and target values, a Live or Reconnecting label and optional controls.
author: jtscott

settings.title: Activities
settings.description: Cards show in this order. Together the activities can read up to 16 entities, the most Kiosk Satellite follows for one plugin.

fields.title: Type
fields.description: A starting point. Vacuum and Climate read their entity's own attributes and offer its controls. Appliance and Custom show what Values sets and can run a script or button.

fields.title: Entity
fields.description: Appliance: its status or operation state sensor. Vacuum: the vacuum. Climate: the thermostat. Custom: any entity. Its state is the card's status unless Values sets one.

fields.title: Title
fields.description: Empty uses the entity's name.

fields.title: Icon
fields.description: Empty uses the entity's icon, if it has one, or the type's.

fields.title: Layout
fields.description: Automatic shows current and target for Climate, a progress bar when Values has a Progress row, otherwise the status and values.

fields.title: Values
fields.description: What the card shows besides the entity's state, such as time left, a progress sensor or a battery level. Each kind uses its first row.

fields.title: Show as
fields.description: Primary: large, on the right. Secondary: under it, with its label. Progress: the bar. Status: under the title. Current and Target: the Current/target layout.

fields.title: Entity
fields.description: Empty reads the activity's entity. A finish time counts down; a duration shows as 1h 4m.

fields.title: Attribute
fields.description: Empty reads the state. Otherwise an attribute name as Developer Tools > States lists it, such as fan_speed.

fields.title: Label
fields.description: Names the value, such as Battery for Battery 80%.

fields.title: Unit
fields.description: Empty uses the entity's unit, which only its state has. Set one for an attribute, such as %.

fields.title: Empty at
fields.description: The value of an empty bar.

fields.title: Full at
fields.description: The value of a full bar, such as 100 for a percentage.

fields.title: Show
fields.description: When the card shows, from an entity's state in Home Assistant.

fields.title: Condition entity
fields.description: Empty uses the activity's entity.

fields.title: States
fields.description: States as Developer Tools > States shows them, separated by commas, such as run, pause or cleaning, returning. unknown and unavailable show the card only when listed under When state is; When state is not always hides them.

fields.title: Controls
fields.description: Cooler and Warmer, within the thermostat's limits and step.

fields.title: Controls
fields.description: The vacuum's buttons, in this order. Each shows only when the vacuum supports it and it applies: Pause while cleaning (Resume while paused), Dock away from the dock, Locate any time, Start from the dock or idle, Stop while cleaning, paused or returning.

fields.title: Action
fields.description: A script or button the card can run, such as one that pauses the appliance. Empty for none.

fields.title: Action label
fields.description: Empty uses the script or button's ID, such as Pause dishwasher.

settings.title: Heading
settings.description: The label at each card's top left. Integration names the integration behind the card's entity, such as LG ThinQ, read from Home Assistant; until it is known, or if it cannot be read, the card says Home Assistant. Entity name is the entity's name in Home Assistant.

settings.title: Heading text
settings.description: Shown on every card. Empty shows only the icon.

settings.title: Buttons
settings.description: How card buttons look. Icon only keeps each button's name for screen readers.

settings.title: Colors
settings.description: Theme follows Kiosk Satellite's light and dark themes. Custom uses the colors below in both, starting from the light theme's. The Live, Reconnecting and Unavailable colors always follow the theme, since they carry meaning.

settings.title: Background
settings.description: The card and the +N more button.

settings.title: Outline
settings.description: The hairline around each card.

settings.title: Text
settings.description: Titles, values and the +N more button.

settings.title: Secondary text
settings.description: The heading, status, labels, the secondary value and notes.

settings.title: Accent
settings.description: Activity icons, button text and icons, and the progress bar while Progress bar is Theme.

settings.title: Controls
settings.description: Buttons, the current/target chip and the progress bar's track.

settings.title: Background opacity
settings.description: How solid the card and the +N more button are, in Theme and Custom colors. Lower lets the screensaver show through.

settings.title: Progress bar
settings.description: Theme uses the accent color. Gradient runs across the whole bar from the start color to the end color, so the color at the tip shows how far along it is.

settings.title: Bar color
settings.description: Solid: the bar. Gradient: its empty end.

settings.title: Gradient end
settings.description: The color at the bar's full end.

settings.title: Maximum cards
settings.description: The most cards shown at once, in list order. A +N more button counts the rest, and the cards the screen has no room for. Tap it to scroll through every card. Taps on the cards go to the cards; tap elsewhere to wake the kiosk.

settings.title: Position
settings.description: Where the cards sit. Top positions grow down, bottom ones grow up and middle ones stay centered. It is not a Kiosk Satellite widget, so pick a spot the screensaver widgets leave empty, or Custom to set its exact position.

settings.title: X
settings.description: From the left edge of the screen to the cards, in dp. Kiosk Satellite stops them at the screen edge, so a value too large for the screen leaves them against the far side.

settings.title: Y
settings.description: From the top edge of the screen to the first card, in dp. Kiosk Satellite stops them at the screen edge, so a value too large for the screen leaves them against the far side.

settings.title: Size
settings.description: Scales the cards, text included. Buttons keep a 44 dp touch target.

buttons.title: Show preview
buttons.label: Show
buttons.description: Shows the cards without the screensaver, for placing them. It shows every enabled activity, even one whose Show condition is not met. Their buttons work in the preview and control the real devices.
